title: `format`
description: A semantic format hint on a string parameter.
question: Is the format constraint present at each capture boundary?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Losing it can allow malformed emails, timestamps, or URIs to reach your server.

notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): `format` is removed from the provider schema and appended to the parameter description as text, e.g. `{format: "email"}` on `owner_email` and `{format: "uri"}` inside the `destination` anyOf branch.
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: `McpToolProvider` maps each `inputSchema` into LangChain4j's own `JsonSchemaElement` model (`JsonObjectSchema`, `JsonStringSchema`, `JsonIntegerSchema`, ...), and the `ToolSpecification` AiServices hands the `ChatModel` is built from that model. `JsonStringSchema` holds a description only, so every `format` (`email`, `date-time`, `uri`) is dropped.
